description.value: Duncan Motel is a roadside motel located on Alexander Street in Duncan, a small city in the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island. Duncan lies along a key Vancouver Island cycling corridor connecting Victoria to Nanaimo and beyond, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists. The property appears to be a standard motel-style accommodation with ground-floor room access typical of the format.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to a Facebook page that returned a 'Temporarily Blocked' error on both the main page and a subpage, yielding no usable business content. All evidence therefore relies solely on OSM tags, which confirm a motel building with internet_access=wlan but provide no amenity detail. Per the rules, OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, so most fields remain null.
